description: This file defines the AuthAttributeBagInterface, a PHP interface for managing a collection of authentication attributes within the OrangeHRM system. It includes method signatures for retrieving, modifying, and inspecting a collection of key-value pairs related to authentication attributes.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all authentication attributes as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys of the authentication attributes.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the current set of attributes with a new array of parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds new attributes to the existing set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the given key, or returns default if key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the attributes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value.
